import os,resource; os.sched_setaffinity(0,sorted(os.sched_getaffinity(0))[:2]); resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_CPU,(115,115)); resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_AS,(6*1024**3,6*1024**3));
from pathlib import Path
import json,hashlib,subprocess,sys,base64,re
p=Path.cwd()
def write(n,s,b=False):
 r=subprocess.run([sys.executable,'-I','-B',str(p/'write_lane.py'),n]+(['--base64'] if b else []),input=base64.b64encode(s).decode() if b else s,text=True,capture_output=True);assert r.returncode==0,r.stderr
r=(p/'reservation.json').read_bytes();assert hashlib.sha256(r).hexdigest()=='fe66642ccebf6279355df3c88d363da5485143520cccc948465a352124bc6bf5'
ids=set(json.loads(r)['ids']);found=[]
root=p.parents[1]/'lanes/pi-mathdb-full-corpus-inventory-r301/corpus'
# exact globally supplied immutable corpus only
for q in sorted(root.glob('mathdb-normalized-chunk-*.jsonl')):
 data=q.read_bytes(); sha=hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest()
 for ln,raw in enumerate(data.splitlines(keepends=True),1):
  obj=json.loads(raw); i=obj.get('mathdb_id',obj.get('id'))
  if i not in ids: continue
  write('originals/'+str(i)+'.jsonl',raw,True)
  tokens=[m.group().decode() for m in re.finditer(rb'"(?:[^"\\]|\\.)*"',raw)]
  entry={'id':i,'chunk':str(q),'chunk_sha256':sha,'onebasedline':ln,'raw_sha256':hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest(),'newline':raw.endswith(b'\n'),'object':obj,'raw_json_string_tokens':tokens,'raw_token_sha256':[hashlib.sha256(t.encode()).hexdigest() for t in tokens]}
  found.append(entry)
assert len(found)==20 and {x['id'] for x in found}==ids
write('original-provenance.json',json.dumps(found,indent=2,ensure_ascii=False))
for x in found: print(json.dumps(x['object'],ensure_ascii=False))
print('CONTRACT RECOVERY')
for n in ['search-budget.json','registry-roots.json','ROOT-PREP.json','inherited-denials.json']:print(n,(p/n).read_text())
